names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 iulie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Chiril», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Κύριλλος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Γορτύνης Κρήτης», with the rank words and the see left off.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Сщмч. Кирилла, еп. Гортинского (III-IV)”; its life: beheaded at the beginning of the fourth century, aged ninety-five.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Кирилла, еп. Гортинского (III-IV)»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 iulie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Chiril»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro's life for this day is the life of a Cyril made «episcop al cetății Gortiniei, din insula Creta», a hieromartyr beheaded «în nouă zile ale lunii iulie» — this man, and not a second Cyril of Gortyna. The account differs from the one this folder was built on: doxologia puts him under Decius and the governor Lucius, gives him fifty years in the see and eighty-four years of age, where the Sretensky life has Diocletian and Maximian, the governor Agrippinus and ninety-five years. The two recensions are recorded side by side and neither is preferred. The Sretensky calendar already names 9 July as a second day of his, which is why the Romanian day is read as the same man's.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Κύριλλος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Γορτύνης Κρήτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους». The Greek calendar keeps him on 14 June where the folder's Romanian row is on 9 July and its Russian row on the Julian 6 September; one attestation row per church is the schema, and those rows are untouched. It is plainly the same man: the bishop of Gortyna in Crete, consecrated at sixty-eight, who governed his flock twenty-five years, was thrown into a fire and left unharmed, and was beheaded in extreme old age. The page dates him «(206 - 299)» and puts the martyrdom under Diocletian and Maximian at the age of ninety-three, where the folder's `dates` note, from days.pravoslavie.ru, has him beheaded at the beginning of the fourth century aged ninety-five; the existing `dates` are left as they are and the page's own figures are recorded here. The page adds that according to Dositheos of Jerusalem there is another Cyril, hieromartyr of Gortyna, who was martyred by the Saracens in 780 and from whose wounds myrrh ran instead of blood — a second man, not this one, and no folder is proposed for him here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn.
Not on the Православни подсетник’s calendar line for 19.09.2026 (6. септембар ст. ст.), nor in its Ohrid Prologue for that day (pravoslavno.rs, checked 2026-08-23).

hymns.text: Гласом божественным от темницы изведен,/ в Риме братию в божественней вере утвердил еси,/ и, от Ангела глаголы приим о святительстей пастве,/ во страдании своем паки гласу с Небесе сподобися,/ богоповеленный святителю и страдальче Кирилле,/ моли за души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 сентября ст. ст. — «Тропарь священномученика Кирилла, епископа Гортинского»

english.text: Led forth from prison by a divine voice, thou didst confirm the brethren in Rome in the divine faith; and having received words from an angel concerning thy hierarchical flock, in thy suffering thou wast again accounted worthy of a voice from heaven, O Cyril, hierarch appointed by God and sufferer: pray for our souls.

hymns.text: Видев себе ради темничныя двери отверсты в полунощи/ и идолы сокрушены,/ и Гортинскую паству святительскую,/ от Бога повеленную, добре упас,/ и по Христе надеждно пострадав,/ священномучениче Кирилле,/ молися за чтущия тя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 сентября ст. ст. — «Кондак священномученика Кирилла, епископа Гортинского»

english.text: Beholding for thy sake the doors of the prison opened at midnight and the idols shattered, and having well shepherded the hierarchical flock of Gortyna entrusted to thee by God, and having suffered for Christ in steadfast hope, O hieromartyr Cyril, pray for those who honour thee.
